sense: on the far side of, further than

terms.grammar: preposition with the accusative; also an adverb
evidence: Quint. 11.2.13: vix eō ultrā līmen ēgressō
Tac. Agr. 30.5: nūlla jam ultrā gēns
terms.comment: Past a point, further than it: ultrā līmen, beyond the threshold. As an adverb, further, any more: nec ultrā. Of measure, beyond: ultrā modum.

terms.gloss: beyond, on the far side of
terms.comment: Across a river, mountains or the sea (see across).

evidence: Verg. G. 4.236: illīs īra modum suprā est
terms.comment: Above and beyond a measure (see above).

phrases.latin: nam vix eō ultrā līmen ēgressō, trīclīnium illud suprā convīvās corruit
phrases.english: for he had hardly stepped beyond the threshold when that dining room fell in on the guests

phrases.latin: nūlla jam ultrā gēns, nihil nisi flūctūs et saxa
phrases.english: there is no people beyond us now, nothing but waves and rocks

phrases.latin: pergeret porrō īre nec ultrā inquīreret
phrases.english: he should go on further and ask no more
